decisions.title: Domain-Driven Modular Monorepo Topology
decisions.summary: Adopt apps/{web,api} and packages/{financial-core,api-contracts,api-client,ui,document-renderer,config} workspace structure preserving 0.0.0.0:3000 entry point.

decisions.title: Statutory Financial Calculation Quarantine in packages/financial-core
decisions.summary: Extract pure statutory GST tax, discount modes, and income tax algorithms into packages/financial-core with zero external dependencies and 100% test parity.

decisions.title: Embedded SQLite Primary Storage with Zero-Loss Recovery Architecture
decisions.summary: Migrate authoritative data layer to embedded local SQLite (data/sqlite/accounting.db) in WAL mode via native DatabaseSync, reconciling meta counters and archiving JSON flat files.
